'''Fan sites''' are independent websites about or supporting [[Star Wars CCG]]. They include browser play platforms and sites that publish decks, strategy, interviews, squadron tables, and regional news.

[[Decklists]] collates the published 60s. Championship sheets stay on their event hubs.

== Video, podcasts and streams ==

Since the 2010s most new SWCCG community content has been video and audio rather than websites. The main creators include the [[Players Committee]] ([[Star Wars CCG (YouTube channel)]], [[Holotheatre]], [[Swccgpc (Twitch channel)|Twitch]]), [[Brandon Baity]] (NanashiStudios), [[Kendall Halman]] ([[Corran on the Horn]]), [[Bill Bisco]] (BillBisco2), [[Dan Tartaglione]] and [[Scott Lingrell]] (crngwell). [[Matt Manning]] publishes [[BoardMatt]]. The full list is at [[Podcasts, video and interviews]].

== Related official outlets ==

[[Radio Free Decipher]] was Decipher's weekly audio show. Squadron call-ins on that show overlap the CEC [[Squadron Members]] roster.
